replaces.idea: A brass-and-copper pneumatic tube dispatch terminal with a cylindrical message canister visible inside a glass window.
A cast-iron clockwork reincarnation watchdog pedestal topped by a domed brass bell and a spring-loaded reset hammer.
A wall-mounted mahogany-and-brass annunciator box with a hinged metal flag dropped down to reveal an amber target.
A hexagonal brass passkey token resting upright in a slotted dark-iron stand, stamped with a keyhole notch.
A bolted steel-and-glass isolation bell jar on an iron baseplate, enclosing a tiny brass gearset safely inside.

new.name: Pneumatic Tube
new.concept: Synchronous IPC message passing between isolated processes
new.depicts: A tall brass-and-copper pneumatic tube terminal standing on a cast-iron base, with two curved glass-windowed pipes and a cylindrical message canister inside.
new.focal: The brass message canister glowing inside the glass tube window

new.name: Reincarnation Bell
new.concept: Reincarnation server watchdog that restarts crashed user-space servers
new.depicts: A squat cast-iron clockwork pedestal topped by a domed brass alarm bell, a side wind-up key, and a spring-loaded reset hammer.
new.focal: The spring-loaded brass hammer poised beside the bell dome

new.name: Drop Annunciator
new.depicts: A small wall-mounted mahogany-and-brass annunciator box with a single hinged metal flag dropped down to reveal a bright amber target.

new.name: Grant Token
new.concept: Safecopy memory grant for capability-based cross-process memory access
new.depicts: A small hexagonal brass passkey token resting upright in a slotted dark-iron stand, stamped with a crisp keyhole notch.
new.focal: The notched keyhole cutout in the brass token

new.name: Driver Bell
new.concept: User-space driver isolation so faulty drivers cannot crash the kernel
new.depicts: A bolted steel-and-glass isolation bell jar mounted on a heavy iron baseplate, enclosing a tiny spinning brass gearset safely inside.
new.focal: The tiny brass gearset sealed behind the thick glass dome

new.name: Ring Carousel
new.depicts: A tabletop brass-and-slate lazy-Susan carousel on a central spindle, holding six slate-and-amber message slots around its rim.
new.focal: The glowing amber slot aligned at the front of the carousel

new.name: Endpoint Jack
new.concept: Process endpoint address used for microkernel IPC routing
new.depicts: A small upright slate switchboard block on rubber feet with a single brass jack socket and a plugged-in braided patch cord.
new.focal: The brass jack socket with its amber collar

new.name: Priority Ratchet
new.depicts: A compact stepped brass ratchet wheel mounted on a dark-iron A-frame stand, with a spring pawl resting on the highest tooth.
new.focal: The stepped brass teeth and clicking pawl

rework.redesign: Redraw as a physical brass-and-slate message-switching rotunda with a small central kernel plinth and four isolated server booths around it connected by pneumatic tubes.
Redraw as a compact 6x6+ px dark-outlined mechanical courier bug with two 1x1 dark eyes and a tiny brass message pouch.
